purpose: Evaluate learned-generator freezing with unchanged same-refold criteria and outcome-independent designability panel.
panel_selection: Select four families per length stratum within each of the four frozen family partitions, ordered by SHA256(seed:familyID); use generation slot0. native_reuse: Reuse exactly the existing eight-design native controls per family and condition, binding audited manifests,reports,refolded arrays and identical constraints/teacher settings. Do not pool attempts or regenerate native design budgets. In every new refold job, repeat its first generated sequence as an execution repeatability check; this is the same sequence and seed, not another design attempt.

Never combine motif retention in one refold with global agreement in another.
secondary: For the fixed32-family slot0 panel, report valid global designability over32 per model/task, separately by length and with paired family bootstrap differences. Include raw-invalid samples as failures. Report motif/scaffold success separately; secondary designability is not motif scaffolding.
